name: Scarlet
description: 政府指定的 AI 和软件医疗器械认证机构，通过 AI 原生平台加速医疗器械的审批流程，将传统 12-18 个月的评估周期大幅缩短
description_en: Government-designated certification body for AI and software medical devices that accelerates approval processes through an AI-native platform, significantly reducing the traditional 12-18 month assessment cycle
why_matters: Scarlet 是全球约 52 家欧盟医疗器械法规指定机构中唯一专注于软件和 AI 的认证机构，获得欧盟、英国 MHRA 和美国 FDA 认可。其 AI 原生认证流程支持客户每月发布两次医疗器械升级，而非传统流程中每次小更新需等待 6-8 个月，从根本上改变了 AI 医疗器械的迭代速度
why_matters_en: Scarlet is the only certification body among roughly 52 EU-designated organisations that specialises in software and AI, holding designations from EU, UK MHRA, and US FDA. Its AI-native process enables customers to release medical device upgrades twice monthly versus 6-8 months delay for minor updates in legacy processes, fundamentally changing AI medical device iteration speed
latest_news: 2026 年 10 月完成 5000 万美元 B 轮融资，由 Headline 领投，Notion Capital、Atomico、Creandum 等参投，将用于美国和亚太市场扩张
latest_news_en: Closed $50M Series B in October 2026 led by Headline with participation from Notion Capital, Atomico, Creandum and others, to support expansion in the US and Asia-Pacific
source_title: Scarlet raises $50M Series B to accelerate AI medical device certification

evidence.quote: today announced a $50 million Series B led by Headline, with participation from new investor Notion Capital and existing investors Atomico, Creandum, Kindred Capital, and Entrepreneurs First
James Dewar and Jamie Cox founded Scarlet in London in 2021 after building AI medical devices at Babylon Health

Among the roughly 52 such organisations designated under the EU Medical Device Regulation, it is, according to the company, the only one that specialises in software and AI, and was truly built to enable AI's iterative development

name: Coval
description: AI电话接待和语音AI代理的自动化测试服务,通过生成多种对话模式检测AI客服在实际场景中的失败情况,包括电话中断、噪音环境、预约信息缺失等复杂情况
description_en: Automated testing service for AI phone reception and voice AI agents, detecting AI customer service failures in real scenarios by generating various conversation patterns including call interruptions, noisy environments, and missing reservation information
why_matters: 随着企业大量部署AI电话系统,确保AI在复杂真实场景下正确应对成为刚需。Coval不仅检查回答正误,更关注电话被打断、背景噪音、复杂问题等实际情况,客户包括Zoom和Deepgram等知名企业
why_matters_en: As companies deploy AI phone systems at scale, ensuring AI handles complex real-world scenarios correctly becomes essential. Coval goes beyond checking answer accuracy to test interruptions, background noise, and complex questions, with customers including Zoom and Deepgram
latest_news_en: Completed $28 million Series A funding on June 24, 2026
source_title: 世界の新ニッチビジネス10選 WORLD BUSINESS RADAR

evidence.quote: 2026年6月24日、同社は2,800万ドルのシリーズA資金調達を発表しました
顧客にはZoomやDeepgramなどが含まれ、AIが顧客対応で失敗しないよう、さまざまな会話パターンを自動生成して検査します

name: Chargeflow
description: 网店退单争议(Chargeback)应对自动化服务,帮助商家收集订单历史、配送记录、用户通信等证据资料,整理并提交给支付服务商处理信用卡争议申诉
description_en: Automated chargeback dispute management service for online stores, helping merchants collect evidence including order history, shipping records, and customer communications to submit to payment processors for credit card dispute resolution
why_matters: 电商卡支付争议处理需要收集多方证据且有时限要求,Chargeflow将这一流程自动化。2025年11月融资时已服务15000家商户,收入同比增长3倍,目前商户网络超过20000家
why_matters_en: E-commerce payment disputes require collecting multi-source evidence with strict deadlines. Chargeflow automates this process. At its November 2025 funding, it served 15,000 merchants with 3x year-over-year revenue growth, now exceeding 20,000 merchant network
latest_news: 2025年11月18日完成3500万美元融资,服务超过20000家商户
latest_news_en: Raised $35 million on November 18, 2025, serving over 20,000 merchants
source_title: 世界の新ニッチビジネス10選 WORLD BUSINESS RADAR

evidence.quote: 2025年11月18日、同社は3,500万ドルの資金調達を発表
発表時点で15,000以上の加盟店にサービスを提供し、売上は前年比3倍になったと説明しています。現在の公式サイトでは、20,000以上の加盟店ネットワークを掲げています

name: Cloud9
description: 跨境支付基础设施与数字商业银行平台,通过稳定币(USDC/USDT)在120多个国家实现实时多币种结算(KES、USD、EUR、GBP、CNY),专注全球贸易走廊,已服务25,000多个商业账户,交易量周增长15%
description_en: Cross-border payment infrastructure and digital business banking platform operating treasury rails across 120+ countries, utilizing stablecoins (USDC/USDT) for real-time multi-currency settlements (KES, USD, EUR, GBP, CNY) targeting global trade corridors, with 25,000+ business accounts and 15% week-over-week transaction volume growth
why_matters: 利用稳定币后端技术突破传统跨境支付瓶颈,覆盖120多个国家的实时结算能力远超区域同类产品,且通过战略收购M-Tickets和Chpter快速整合支付与社交商务场景,建立差异化护城河
why_matters_en: Breaks through traditional cross-border payment bottlenecks using stablecoin backend technology, with real-time settlement capability across 120+ countries far exceeding regional peers, and rapidly integrates payment with social commerce scenarios through strategic acquisitions of M-Tickets and Chpter
latest_news: 2026年完成50万美元股权融资(pre-seed轮总融资达100万美元),由Alliance领投,Techstars NYC及战略天使投资人跟投
latest_news_en: $500,000 equity round in 2026 (bringing total pre-seed to $1M), led by Alliance with Techstars NYC and strategic angels
source_title: African Startup Deal Tracker — Newest Deals - Launch Base Africa

evidence.quote: $500,000 Equity (Part of an ongoing pre-seed round, bringing total funding to $1 million) Investor: Alliance (Lead; alongside Techstars NYC and strategic angels)
Launched in early 2026, Cloud9 has onboarded 25,000+ business accounts with transaction volume growing 15% week-over-week
Operates treasury rails across 120+ countries, utilizing stablecoins (USDC/USDT) on the backend for real-time multi-currency settlements (KES, USD, EUR, GBP, CNY) targeting global trade corridors

name: Industrial Next
description: 开发AI驱动的自包含机器人工作站，通过专有基础模型连接视觉、任务上下文和运动，让工厂产线能在几分钟内重新配置而非数周，无需传统编程即可自动化复杂精密任务
description_en: Develops AI-driven, self-contained robotic stations powered by proprietary foundation models that connect vision, task context and motion, enabling factory production lines to be retooled in minutes rather than weeks without traditional programming for complex and delicate task automation
why_matters: 使用高保真仿真引擎训练机器人执行高精度装配任务，已成功部署在全球最受欢迎智能手机之一的生产线上，完成制造商多年无法自动化的任务如穿线软性排线和扣接微小连接器帽，剥膜工作站达到或超过人类速度且100%准确率
why_matters_en: Uses extremely high-fidelity simulation engine to train robots for high-precision assembly tasks, already deployed in production of one of the world's most popular smartphones, handling tasks manufacturers failed to automate for years such as threading delicate flex cables and snapping tiny connector caps, with film peeling stations achieving at or above human speed with 100% accuracy
latest_news: 2026年10月13日在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield舞台展示，宣布与宝马集团技术办公室(BMW Group Technology Office)合作评估其AI驱动的灵巧操作技术用于制造
latest_news_en: Presented on Startup Battlefield stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on October 13, 2026, announced partnership with BMW Group Technology Office to evaluate AI-powered dexterous manipulation for manufacturing
source_title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks

evidence.quote: Industrial Next was founded in 2021 by Lukas Pankau and Allen Pan, both of whom previously worked at Tesla. Pankau served as a lead electrical architect at Tesla before moving on to Waymo. Pan led Tesla's autonomous factory efforts and later became a chief architect at autonomous driving company Neolix.

The secret sauce for the robots that we have is that we have given them an understanding of the process in general, but we build that understanding using an extremely high-fidelity simulation engine that is close to the real dynamics to where we can let the robot do these kinds of high precision tasks almost without seeing the parts at all.

some of the startup's workstations are already used in making one of the world's most popular smartphones. They handle tasks that manufacturers had tried and failed to automate for years, such as threading a delicate flex cable and snapping a tiny connector cap into place.

name: Promise Robotics
description: 一家建筑科技初创公司,使用AI驱动的机器人在工厂中组装房屋部件,通过集成平台解读房屋设计、生成生产计划、协调制造并连接现场安装
description_en: A construction tech startup using AI-powered robots to assemble housing components in factories, with an integrated platform that interprets home designs, generates production plans, orchestrates manufacturing, and connects production with site installation
why_matters: 已签约建造超过2500套房屋,完成200多个实际交付项目,获得美国最大住宅建筑商DR Horton多年商业协议,将在凤凰城生产超过1250套住宅,证明其工厂即服务模式在解决劳动力短缺和建造成本问题上的市场认可度
why_matters_en: Contracted to build over 2,500 homes with 200+ completed builds delivered to real occupants, secured multi-year commercial agreement with DR Horton (largest US homebuilder by volume) to produce 1,250+ homes in Phoenix, demonstrating market validation of its factory-as-a-service model in addressing labor shortages and construction cost challenges
latest_news: 2026年10月与美国最大住宅建筑商DR Horton达成多年商业协议,将在凤凰城开设1.6万平方英尺工厂,预计2027年初投产,这是其首个美国设施和第三个工厂
latest_news_en: In October 2026, secured multi-year commercial agreement with DR Horton, the largest US homebuilder, and announced plans to open a 16,000-square-foot factory in Phoenix expected to begin manufacturing in early 2027, marking its first US facility and third factory overall
source_title: Promise Robotics strikes deal to supply largest US homebuilder DR Horton

website_verification.title: Promise Robotics - Physical AI for Homebuilding Promise Robotics

evidence.quote: Promise, which is now contracted to build just over 2,500 homes for several different homebuilders, has completed over 200 builds to date for a group that includes Brookfield, Hopewell, and Mattamy

Promise uses AI to interpret existing home designs, generate production plans and robotic instructions, orchestrate manufacturing, and connect that production with site installation as part of one integrated platform
